description:
Follow-ups item 9 (unit 3g), the tests half: page paths and plain links, and the pin.
- every_cms_page_path_serves_the_frontend_and_no_api_path_does: /cms/, /cms/settings, /cms/paint/{page}, an unknown /cms/ path and a file's page each serve the built-in's page; no /cms/api path does (each answers no-such-route); /cms/settings?format=html is a redirect to the settings route's page.
- NV-7 (builtin navigation, on lichen, Hugo and mdBook): /cms/settings and an unknown /cms/ path opened directly land on their views; back, forward and reload move between the settings view and the files; a typed /cms/edit/{content}/blog/my-first-post.md opens its file and stays as typed; my post.md links as my%20post.md, the rest of its path plain, and opens there.
- t_cms_utils_arms' docstrings name the functions they reach now (lichen-adversary's note on #1055): filetree_view, and read_room_file's unreadable arm.

Commits: 8af6a03d (the tests, the docstrings, the pin), 65650b18 and 470cb195 (rustfmt), and merges of the product branch.
Rust: yes (one test). API contract: unchanged by this half.
Checks on lichen-ci: the gate at this tip is in the product PR. Red arms (notify-e558b484, at 65650b18, whose code and tests differ from this tip only by rustfmt and the product's later test fixes): without the /cms/{*page} route the Rust test fails; with prettyPath encoding the whole path as one segment, the builtin navigation suite fails (first at NV-2's plain tree link, before NV-7); the baseline passes.
